existing_fee_payment_rules.legal_concept: Permission to charge a fee for copies (non-commercial)
existing_fee_payment_rules.atomic_rule: The custodian may charge a fee for furnishing copies, printouts or photographs if the facilities are available; the statute sets no rate.
existing_fee_payment_rules.trigger: Copies are furnished and copying facilities are available.
existing_fee_payment_rules.source_language: The custodian of such records shall promptly furnish such copies, printouts or photographs and may charge a fee if the facilities are available, except that public records for purposes listed in section 39-122 or 39-127 shall be furnished without charge.
existing_fee_payment_rules.notes: constraint_basis=soft-standard: state authorizes a fee but supplies no number; the city sets the per-copy rate. Arizona case law limits non-commercial fees to copying-related costs (not personnel time); that gloss is not automated here.

existing_fee_payment_rules.atomic_rule: For a commercial-purpose request the charge may include (1) a portion of the cost to the public body for obtaining the original or copies, (2) a reasonable fee for time, materials, equipment and personnel in producing the reproduction, and (3) the value of the reproduction on the commercial market as best determined by the public body.
existing_fee_payment_rules.trigger: Request classified as commercial purpose and commercial-purpose statement provided.
existing_fee_payment_rules.source_language: Upon being furnished the statement the custodian of such records may furnish reproductions, the charge for which shall include the following: 1. A portion of the cost to the public body for obtaining the original or copies of the documents, printouts or photographs. 2. A reasonable fee for the cost of time, materials, equipment and personnel in producing such reproduction. 3. The value of the reproduction on the commercial market as best determined by the public body.
existing_fee_payment_rules.notes: Same fee concept family as AZ-0018 but a distinct commercial basis; state defines the components, the city determines the amounts (hence soft-standard, includes a 'reasonable fee' and market-value element).

existing_fee_payment_rules.legal_concept: No charge for records used in claims against the United States
existing_fee_payment_rules.atomic_rule: State, county, and municipal officers shall furnish, without charge, searches for and certified copies of public records needed in support of a claim or benefit application against the United States.
existing_fee_payment_rules.trigger: Records requested for use in a claim/benefit application against the United States by a claimant, guardian, or attorney.
existing_fee_payment_rules.source_language: Free searches for and copies of public records to be used in claims against United States; liability for noncompliance. [Officers] shall furnish without charge certified copies of and make searches for public records to be used in prosecuting any claim or securing any benefit to which the claimant may be entitled from the United States.
existing_fee_payment_rules.notes: is_paraphrase=true: the fetched source returned a summary with only fragment quotes; the reconstructed clause needs verbatim confirmation against azleg. Fee-waiver branch cross-referenced by AZ-0011/AZ-0018.

existing_fee_payment_rules.legal_concept: Free copy of police report for crime victims
existing_fee_payment_rules.atomic_rule: A victim of a listed offense (or the victim's attorney, or immediate family of a deceased/incapacitated victim) has the right to receive one copy of the police report, and audio/video recordings, at no charge.
existing_fee_payment_rules.trigger: Requester is a qualifying crime victim (or representative) requesting the police report of that offense.
existing_fee_payment_rules.source_language: Free copies of police reports, audio recordings, video recordings and transcripts for crime victims. [The victim] has the right to receive one copy of the police report... at no cost.
existing_fee_payment_rules.notes: is_paraphrase=true: source returned a summary with fragment quotes; needs verbatim confirmation. Distinct fee-waiver + qualification workflow (requester must qualify as victim).

existing_fee_payment_rules.legal_concept: Advance payment for copying and postage on mailed copies
existing_fee_payment_rules.atomic_rule: The custodian may require a person requesting a mailed copy to pay in advance for any copying and postage charges.
existing_fee_payment_rules.trigger: Requester asks the custodian to mail a copy.
existing_fee_payment_rules.source_language: The custodian may require any person requesting that the custodian mail a copy of any public record to pay in advance for any copying and postage charges.
existing_fee_payment_rules.notes: constraint_basis=ceiling: advance charge is limited to copying + postage; the city supplies the actual amounts. Applies only to mailed copies.

existing_fee_payment_rules.legal_concept: Commercial reproductions provided upon payment of the determined fee
existing_fee_payment_rules.atomic_rule: If no gubernatorial order issues within thirty days of a custodian's application, the custodian shall provide the commercial reproductions upon being paid the fee determined under § 39-121.03(A).
existing_fee_payment_rules.trigger: Governor issues no prohibiting order within 30 days of the custodian's application.
existing_fee_payment_rules.clock_spec: 30 calendar-days from custodian's application to the governor
existing_fee_payment_rules.source_language: If no order is issued within thirty days of the date of application, the custodian of public records shall provide such copies, printouts or photographs upon being paid the fee determined pursuant to subsection A.
existing_fee_payment_rules.notes: Release is conditioned on payment of the AZ-0019 fee once the 30-day governor window lapses without an order.
